test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six boys P, Q, R, S, T and W are compared on the basis of their age (not necessarily in the same order). Age of no two boys is same. Only four boys are younger that Q. S is elder to P and R. T is elder to W and S.

Who is the eldest amongst them?
solution:
According to the given information:

1) Age of no two boys is same. 

2) Only four boys are younger that Q.

_ > Q > _ > _ > _ > _

3) S is elder to P and R.

S > P / R

4) T is elder to W and S.

T > W / S

So, there can be multiple cases here:

Case 1: T > Q > S > W > P > R
